name: @loom/experience-stepped
description: A container-renderer seam reference, non-genUI: a bike-share rider onboarding registers its own `stepped` renderer for a `role: "stepped"` column container (Blueprint IR 2.2.0, loom ADR 0099) — Back/Next chrome the app owns, step mount/reconcile/subscriptions the adapter owns. Paging shows exactly one step, accessibly (hidden + inert + aria-hidden); setRole toggles chrome in and out; a step title change patches chrome with no remount; appending a step remounts none of the existing ones; a throwing renderer falls back to plain; the terminal prints every step, role ignored.
